name: puppy
source:
A small visual novel about a character who has trauma, it is hard to get an ending where you don't abandon or hurt him but it is possible. His job is being a punching bag and you're his new client, will you be better than the rest or will you just take out your anger and frustrations?

[from [url=https://cheesychilaquil.itch.io/puppy]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一部关于遭受创伤的角色的小型视觉小说，很难得到一个不抛弃或不伤害他的结局，但这是可能的。他的工作就是当出气筒，而你是他的新客户，你会比其他人更好，还是会发泄你的愤怒和沮丧？

[来自[url=https://cheesychilaquil.itch.io/puppy]itch.io[/url]]
